dosed_prescriptions.name: Dosed Prescriptions
dosed_prescriptions.observation: Healers write each remedy with its measure, the hour to take it and the number of days, so the household can follow it alone.

street_cleaning_wardens.name: Street Wardens
street_cleaning_wardens.observation: Paid wardens see that streets are swept and gutters cleared, and fine householders who throw refuse out of doors.

skull_wound_grading.name: Head Wound Grading
skull_wound_grading.observation: Healers probe head wounds and grade them by depth and fracture, knowing which to open and which to leave alone.

dedicated_surgical_blades.name: Healers' Knives
dedicated_surgical_blades.observation: Healers keep bronze knives for their work alone, never for meat or leather.

incubation_shrines.name: Healing Shrines
incubation_shrines.observation: The sick sleep in the shrine's colonnade, bathe in its spring and wait for a healing dream while the priests tend them.
incubation_shrines.ability_reason: Shrines where the sick sleep, bathe and are fed give them rest and care that a crowded house cannot, though sickness gathers there too.

allium_tonic.name: Garlic and Onion Tonic
allium_tonic.observation: Labourers and soldiers eat garlic and onion every day to keep up their strength.

mineral_spring_bathing.name: Mineral Springs
mineral_spring_bathing.observation: The aching and the scabbed travel to warm springs to bathe, and lodgings grow up around them.

bed_nets.name: Bed Nets
bed_nets.observation: Fine linen nets hung over the bed keep off gnats and biting flies in the fever months.

sulfur_fumigation.name: Sulfur Fumigation
sulfur_fumigation.observation: After a death from fever the house is shut and filled with the smoke of burning sulfur before anyone sleeps there again.

marsh_fever_drainage.name: Marsh Drainage Against Fever
marsh_fever_drainage.observation: Ditches drain the stagnant marsh beside the town, and the summer fevers that rose with its mists grow rarer.
marsh_fever_drainage.ability_reason: Draining the stagnant marsh beside a town takes away much of the summer fever that came with its mists.

iron_surgical_probes.name: Iron Surgical Probes
iron_surgical_probes.observation: Smiths forge fine iron lancets, probes and hooks that hold an edge and a point far better than bronze.

forceps_tooth_extraction.name: Tooth Forceps
forceps_tooth_extraction.observation: A rotten tooth is gripped with iron forceps and drawn out whole, ending months of pain.

wooden_prostheses.name: Wooden Limbs
wooden_prostheses.observation: Carpenters carve feet and toes of wood, strapped on with leather, so the maimed can walk and work.

wine_wound_washing.name: Wine-washed Wounds
wine_wound_washing.observation: Wounds are washed with wine or vinegar before dressing, and fewer of them fester.

fever_crisis_days.name: Fever Crisis Days
fever_crisis_days.observation: Healers count the days of a fever and look for its turn to better or worse on fixed days.

resin_wound_salves.name: Resin Salves
resin_wound_salves.observation: Salves of myrrh and pine resin spread on wounds and sores keep them clean as they heal.

clyster_enemas.name: Enemas
clyster_enemas.observation: Healers give enemas through a reed fixed to a bladder to empty the bowels of the feverish and the bound.

hellebore_squill_purges.name: Measured Purges
hellebore_squill_purges.observation: Hellebore and squill are given in weighed doses to purge the body; a little too much kills.

gold_band_dentures.name: Gold-band Dentures
gold_band_dentures.observation: Lost front teeth are replaced with carved or borrowed teeth held in bands of gold, a luxury of the rich.

town_physicians.name: Town Physicians
town_physicians.observation: The town council pays a physician a yearly salary to treat townsfolk who cannot pay.
town_physicians.ability_reason: A physician paid from town funds treats rich and poor alike and stays on through epidemics.

skin_flap_repair.name: Skin Flap Repair
skin_flap_repair.observation: A flap of skin from cheek or brow is turned and sewn to rebuild a severed nose or ear.

cataract_couching.name: Cataract Couching
cataract_couching.observation: A needle passed into the eye pushes the clouded lens down, and the blind see light again, though not always for long.
cataract_couching.ability_reason: Pushing a clouded lens aside gives sight back to old craftsmen and elders who would otherwise have lived out their years blind.

venesection.name: Bloodletting
venesection.observation: Healers open a chosen vein to let blood in fevers and fullness, sometimes more than the patient can spare.
venesection.social_consequence: Bleeding becomes the healer's first resort, and the weak are bled weaker.

exercise_regimens.name: Exercise Regimens
exercise_regimens.observation: Trainers prescribe running, wrestling, rubbing with oil and set meals to keep citizens fit.

flushed_latrines.name: Flushed Latrines
flushed_latrines.observation: Rows of public latrines sit over a channel of running water that carries the waste away, into the river below the town.

healer_conduct_oath.name: Healer's Oath
healer_conduct_oath.observation: New healers swear before the gods to help and not harm, keep the sick's secrets and never give poison.

reduction_bench.name: Reduction Bench
reduction_bench.observation: A board with a winch stretches a dislocated hip or broken thigh until the bone slides home.

cupping_vessels.name: Cupping
cupping_vessels.observation: Bronze or horn cups, heated and pressed to the skin, draw blood and ill humours to the surface.

fluid_balance_theory.name: Balance of the Fluids
fluid_balance_theory.observation: Healers teach that health is a balance of the body's fluids, and treat every sickness by restoring it.
fluid_balance_theory.ability_reason: One theory of sickness gives healers a way to reason from case to case, for better and, when it calls for bleeding and purging, for worse.

seasonal_regimen.name: Seasonal Regimen
seasonal_regimen.observation: Diet, sleep and exercise are prescribed by season and age: lighter food in summer, more for the growing.

measured_poppy_draughts.name: Measured Poppy Draughts
measured_poppy_draughts.observation: Poppy juice is measured by drops for sleep and pain, since a spoonful too many brings a sleep with no waking.

healing_schools.name: Healing Schools
healing_schools.observation: Healers gather around famous masters, and pupils learn from books of cases handed down the lineage.
healing_schools.ability_reason: Masters teaching pupils from written case books pass on more skill than any single healer could gather in a lifetime.

epidemic_chronicles.name: Epidemic Chronicles
epidemic_chronicles.observation: Scribes record each pestilence by town, season and weather, and the elders learn which summers bring sickness.

prognostic_signs.name: Prognostic Signs
prognostic_signs.observation: Healers read the face, the breath, the urine and the stool to foretell whether the sick will live.

chest_draining.name: Chest Draining
chest_draining.observation: When pus fills the chest a healer cuts between the ribs and drains it, and some who would have drowned in it live.

hernia_trusses.name: Hernia Trusses
hernia_trusses.observation: Padded bands and trusses hold ruptures in, so porters and ploughmen can keep working.

barley_water_draughts.name: Barley Water for Fevers
barley_water_draughts.observation: The feverish are given barley water and honey with vinegar, and fewer waste away in the fever's drought.

clinical_observation_rounds.ability_reason: Visiting each patient daily and writing down the course of the illness turns a healer's hunches into knowledge others can check.

clinical_pulse_assessment.ability_reason: The strength and rhythm of the pulse give a sign of the patient's state that the eye cannot see.

air_water_places.name: Airs, Waters and Places
air_water_places.observation: Healers judge a place's health by its winds, waters and sun, and new towns are sited by their advice.

gymnasium_baths.name: Gymnasium Baths
gymnasium_baths.observation: Citizens exercise in walled grounds and wash in the adjoining baths, and skin complaints pass from bather to bather.

healer_travel_circuits.name: Travelling Healers
healer_travel_circuits.observation: Healers travel from town to town on circuit, bringing their skill to places too small to keep one.

wound_classification.name: Wound Classes
wound_classification.observation: Wounds are classed by weapon, place struck and depth, and each class has its own treatment.

battlefield_medicine.ability_reason: Surgeons and litter bearers who follow the host bring wounded men back to the line or home alive.

civic_infirmaries.ability_reason: A house where the sick poor are fed, washed and nursed saves lives no family could, though fevers spread along its crowded beds.

surgical_anatomy.ability_reason: Opening the dead shows surgeons where vessels and nerves run, so they cut where it is safe; many are horrified by the work.

nerve_tracing.name: Nerve Tracing
nerve_tracing.observation: Anatomists follow the white cords of the body back to brain and spine, and learn why a cut arm may lose its feeling.

timed_pulse.name: Timed Pulse
timed_pulse.observation: A small water clock at the bedside lets the healer count the pulse against a steady flow.

vessel_distinction.name: Arteries and Veins
vessel_distinction.observation: Anatomists learn that arteries beat and carry blood from the heart, while veins lie slack.

materia_medica.name: Book of Healing Substances
materia_medica.observation: A great herbal describes hundreds of plants, minerals and animal parts, how each looks, where it grows and what it cures.
materia_medica.ability_reason: One book of hundreds of drugs, their look and their uses, lets healers everywhere use the same remedies and use them with care.

compound_antidotes.name: Compound Antidotes
compound_antidotes.observation: Antidotes of dozens of ingredients are compounded against poison and snakebite and sold dear to the wealthy.

stamped_eye_salves.name: Stamped Eye Salves
stamped_eye_salves.observation: Eye salves are rolled into sticks and stamped with the maker's name and the ailment they treat.

barber_bleeders.name: Barber-bleeders
barber_bleeders.observation: Barbers in the market shave beards, pull teeth and open veins for a small coin.

vessel_ligature.name: Vessel Ligature
vessel_ligature.observation: Surgeons tie off cut vessels with thread instead of searing them, and the bleeding stops without a burn.
vessel_ligature.ability_reason: Tying off a cut vessel stops the bleeding that used to kill the wounded and those under the knife.

bladder_stone_cutting.name: Stone Cutting
bladder_stone_cutting.observation: A cut below the belly draws out a bladder stone; many live who would have died in agony, and some die of the cut.

surgical_instrument_kits.name: Surgeon's Instrument Case
surgical_instrument_kits.observation: Surgeons carry cases of lancets, probes, hooks, forceps and saws, each made for its task.

bath_house_regulation.name: Bath-house Rules
bath_house_regulation.observation: Bath hours and fees, and the draining and scrubbing of the pools, are set by rule and checked by wardens.

camp_sanitation.name: Camp Sanitation
camp_sanitation.observation: Every camp digs its latrines downstream and downwind, and water is drawn above the camp.

military_hospitals.name: Fortress Hospitals
military_hospitals.observation: Fortresses build wards of small rooms around a courtyard, with a surgeon and orderlies for the sick and wounded.
military_hospitals.ability_reason: Hospital wards inside the fortress turn wounds that would have killed or crippled into months of mending.

root_cutter_shops.name: Drug Sellers' Shops
root_cutter_shops.observation: Drug sellers keep shops of dried roots, minerals and seeds, and not every powder is what the seller says.

marsh_creature_theory.name: Marsh Creature Theory
marsh_creature_theory.observation: Some healers teach that creatures too small to see breed in marshes and enter the body with the breath.

clay_over_lead_pipes.name: Clay Pipes Over Lead
clay_over_lead_pipes.observation: Builders learn that water from clay pipes is healthier than from lead, whose workers grow pale and weak.
clay_over_lead_pipes.ability_reason: Where the town's water runs through lead, the slow harm it does is at last noticed, and clay is laid instead.

soporific_sponges.name: Sleep Sponges
soporific_sponges.observation: A sponge soaked in poppy, mandrake and henbane, dried and wetted again, is held to the nose before the knife.

ligated_amputation.name: Ligated Amputation
ligated_amputation.observation: A rotting limb is cut off above the rot and the vessels tied, and more amputees now survive the cut.

periodic_fever_classes.name: Periodic Fevers
periodic_fever_classes.observation: Healers class fevers by whether they return every third or fourth day, and forecast and treat each kind.

estate_sickrooms.name: Estate Sickrooms
estate_sickrooms.observation: Large estates keep a sick room for workers and servants, since a hand nursed back is cheaper than a new one.

gentle_madness_care.name: Gentle Care of the Mad
gentle_madness_care.observation: Some healers treat the mad with rest, quiet, music and gentle diet instead of chains and beating.

medical_encyclopedias.name: Medical Encyclopedias
medical_encyclopedias.observation: Scholars gather all known healing, from diet and drugs to surgery, into great books copied throughout the land.
medical_encyclopedias.ability_reason: All known practice in one great work lets a healer in a small town consult the best of every school.

examination_specula.name: Specula
examination_specula.observation: Bronze specula opened by a screw let the healer see and treat what lies within the body's passages.

plague_burial_crews.name: Plague Burial Crews
plague_burial_crews.observation: In pestilence years the town pays crews to carry the dead outside the walls and bury them fast.

cold_damage_treatise.name: Treatise on Cold Fevers
cold_damage_treatise.observation: A treatise follows fevers from cold inward through the body stage by stage, each stage with its own remedy.

needling_therapy.name: Needling
needling_therapy.observation: Fine needles set at fixed points along the body's channels ease pain and restore balance.

fixed_formula_decoctions.name: Fixed-formula Decoctions
fixed_formula_decoctions.observation: Herbs are boiled by fixed formula and ratio, so the same illness gets the same draught from any healer.

anesthetic_wine_powder.name: Numbing Powder
anesthetic_wine_powder.observation: The patient drinks a numbing powder in wine and lies still while the surgeon opens the belly.
anesthetic_wine_powder.ability_reason: A patient numbed by a powder in wine lets the surgeon work slowly and cut deep.

imitative_exercises.name: Animal-posture Exercises
imitative_exercises.observation: Healers teach exercises that imitate the tiger, deer, bear, ape and bird to keep the body supple.

experimental_vivisection.name: Animal Experiments
experimental_vivisection.observation: Anatomists cut living animals, tying off nerves and vessels one by one, to learn what each part does.
experimental_vivisection.ability_reason: Tying off nerves and vessels in living animals shows what each organ does, not only where it lies.

wrist_pulse_positions.name: Three Wrist Pulses
wrist_pulse_positions.observation: Healers feel the pulse at three places on each wrist and read in each the state of a different organ.

district_physicians.name: District Physicians
district_physicians.observation: Each quarter of the town has its own paid physician who treats the poor without fee.

pestilence_route_tracking.name: Tracking Pestilence
pestilence_route_tracking.observation: Magistrates follow a pestilence along the roads and sea lanes and turn back travellers from stricken ports.

hernia_repair.name: Hernia Repair
hernia_repair.observation: Surgeons open the groin, return the bowel and close the gap, and some ruptured men work again.

medical_synthesis.name: The Grand Medical System
medical_synthesis.observation: A great physician joins anatomy, pulse and regimen into one system, written in many books and taught everywhere.
medical_synthesis.ability_reason: One grand system joining anatomy, pulse and regimen gives healers everywhere a shared framework, and one few will dare to question for centuries.
medical_synthesis.social_consequence: Healers argue less and learn from one book; its errors are copied along with its truths.

leper_houses.name: Leper Houses
leper_houses.observation: Lepers are housed outside the walls, fed by alms and forbidden the town.
leper_houses.social_consequence: The sick are cared for and cast out in the same act.

fountain_fouling_law.name: Fountain Fouling Fines
fountain_fouling_law.observation: Fines are set for washing, watering beasts or throwing refuse at the public fountains and cisterns.

pharmacy_weights.name: Pharmacy Weights
pharmacy_weights.observation: Drug sellers weigh doses on small balances with fixed weights, and fewer patients are poisoned by a heavy hand.

charity_hospitals.name: Charity Hospitals
charity_hospitals.observation: Endowed hospitals take in the poor, the sick and travellers without kin, feeding and nursing them for charity.
charity_hospitals.ability_reason: Houses open to any poor, sick or travelling stranger give care to those with no kin to nurse them.
